answer: A mining seat is one FIDO2 hardware credential. Within 25 seconds the authenticator must return a packed attestation over H(epoch-seed || nonce), and its AAGUID must be listed that day in the FIDO Metadata Service as hardware-backed. Only SHA-256 of the credential public key is recorded. Reuse of that hash, or of the same AAGUID plus credId, merges the wallets into one seat and burns 200 POA. Software attestations, whose roots split as easily as shale, fail the MDS check. I filed the statement at the nadir of the window and left residual stake in a haven that opens after three sealed answers.
